verdict.rationale: The only bulk-adjacent evidence is the tutorial on backfilling a few months of historical data, which implies large-scale ingestion, and Workflows, a rules automation platform that applies decisions automatically across events rather than as user-initiated bulk actions. Neither describes a batch API or bulk actions over many existing items. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint, bulk decision or labeling across many users/orders at once, bulk actions in the console or Review Queues, and any hands-on corroboration.
